title: IELTS GT Writing Practice Test 7 — Job Application Letter
instructions: Task 1: Write a letter of at least 150 words. Task 2: Write an essay of at least 250 words.

questions.letterSituation: You have seen a job advertisement for a Marketing Assistant position at a large retail company. The role requires experience in social media management, customer service, and event organisation — all of which you have.
questions.prompt:
You have seen a job advertisement for a Marketing Assistant position at a large retail company. The role requires experience in social media management, customer service, and event organisation — all of which you have.

Write a letter in response to this situation. In your letter:
• explain why you are writing and where you saw the advertisement
• describe your relevant experience and qualifications
• ask for information about the application process and interview dates

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should open with an appropriate greeting, address each bullet point in a separate paragraph with specific detail, maintain the correct register throughout, and close with a suitable sign-off.

questions.prompt: Many companies now allow employees to work from home instead of commuting to an office. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend for employees and employers?
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should present a clear position supported by well-developed arguments, relevant specific examples, and a logical structure including a focused introduction, detailed body paragraphs, and a concise conclusion.
